gloss: shrewd; sharp; never missing a chance

definitions.gloss: shrewd; sharp; never missing a chance
definitions.explanation: Quick to notice and take every opportunity for gain; often with a hint of calculation.

examples.japanese: {抜|ぬ}け{目|め}ない⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{商売|しょうばい}→商売：03239_shoubai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{抜|ぬ}け{目|め}ない。

{抜|ぬ}け{目|め}なく⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{好|この}み→好み：02767_konomi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べて→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{企画|きかく}→企画：04879_kikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提案|ていあん}した→提案する：06057_teiansuru⟧。
examples.english: She shrewdly found out what her boss liked before pitching the plan.

notes:
Literally "without gaps": {抜|ぬ}け{目|め} is an oversight or opening. Also said as ⟦{抜|ぬ}け{目|め}がない→抜け目がない：28319_nukemeganai⟧. Usually admiring, but it can suggest someone who looks out only for themselves.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{抜|ぬ}け{目|め}ない: shrewd about ~ (⟦{商売|しょうばい}→商売：03239_shoubai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, ⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧)
- {抜|ぬ}け{目|め}なく + verb: shrewdly, missing nothing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ちゃっかり→ちゃっかり：06277_chakkari⟧: cheekily taking advantage; lighter and more casual
- {抜|ぬ}かり⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: leaving nothing out; about careful preparation rather than gain
